newsitem.title: USA: Mobil restarts Beaumont, Texas, cracker - traders.
newsitem.headline: Mobil restarts Beaumont, Texas, cracker - traders.

text.p: Mobil Corp has restarted a 45,000-barrel-per-day hydrocracker taken down for scheduled maintenance at its Beaumont, Texas, refinery in early January, traders said.
"It's been back at least since Thursday," one player said, speculating the return of the unit would put added downward pressure on gasoline differentials in the Gulf Coast.
Mobil, citing company policy, said it was unable to comment on maintenance at the 325,000-bpd refinery.
Another trader said Mobil was seen selling gas Thursday in the Gulf, "which they haven't done for awhile."
